crossRefs.note: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears Yahweh, who delights greatly in his commandments.
crossRefs.keyword: Praise ye the Lord. Heb. Hallelujah

crossRefs.note: Rejoice in Yahweh, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.
Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
Praise Yahweh, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.
Praise Yahweh, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.
Look! Praise Yahweh, all you servants of Yahweh, who stand by night in Yahweh’s house!
Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh’s name! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,
House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!
All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.
speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;

translations.web: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of Yahweh, praise Yahweh’s name.
translations.bsb: Hallelujah! Give praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
translations.kjv: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
translations.asv: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise, O ye servants of Jehovah, Praise the name of Jehovah.
